text: The customer wants all 12 Lumo Hubs from order LM-52210 delivered by November 21 for an installation, as only 3 have arrived so far. The previous agent confirmed that the remaining units are split into two shipments arriving on November 20 (5 units) and November 23 (4 units), and offered to ask the courier to expedite the final shipment without a guarantee. Next, we need to contact the courier to request expedited delivery for the last 4 units and update the customer by tomorrow at noon.
